About Xingchen Wang

Professional Profile

I am a technical leader specialising in image algorithms research and developmentand computer vision engineering. My work sits at the intersection of rigorous algorithmic thinking and practical product delivery — designing imaging pipelines, directing R&D initiatives, and helping teams ship high-quality visual systems at scale.

I am driven by hard problems in computational imaging and enjoy the challenge of turning cutting-edge research into reliable, production-ready software.

Areas of Expertise

Core Technical

  • Computational imaging & image quality algorithms
  • Computer vision and visual perception systems
  • Image processing pipeline architecture (RAW, ISP, post-processing)
  • Deep learning for imaging and vision tasks

Engineering & Leadership

  • Technical project leadership and cross-functional team management
  • Algorithm research to production roadmaps
  • Code review, system design, and engineering quality practices
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration (hardware, optics, software, product)

Tools & Technologies

  • Languages: C++, Python, Shell
  • Build & tooling: CMake, Git
  • Frameworks & libraries: OpenCV, JUCE

Open Source

I maintain and share public projects on GitHub, including tooling to simplify OpenCV builds, reusable JUCE components, and a CMake project template for C++.

Let's Connect

The best ways to reach me are viaLinkedIn orGitHub. I'm always happy to discuss imaging algorithms, open-source projects, or opportunities to collaborate.
